layout_summary: A centered, vertical single-column layout on a dark burgundy canvas featuring a brand logo at the top, a two-line serif headline above a large hand-drawn head outline containing a photographic cake cutout, and a website URL anchored at the bottom.

alignment_axes: logo (e1), headline (e2), central illustration/product group (e3, ornament), and footer URL (e4) are all centered on the vertical axis at x=50%
whitespace: 7.5% vertical gap between logo (y=9.5%) and headline (y=17%)
8.5% vertical gap between headline (y=26.5%) and top of head illustration (y=35%)
13.5% vertical gap between bottom of head illustration (y=79.5%) and footer URL (y=93%)
generous 22.5% to 25% horizontal margins flanking the central stack

scene.subject: A rectangular slice of layered strawberry cream pastry with freeze-dried red berry crumble on top and creamy filling with fruit chunks.
scene.composition: Centered horizontally and slightly above vertical center inside the cranial cavity of the white line-art head profile.
scene.camera: Eye-level macro product shot with sharp focus across the pastry cross-section.
scene.lighting: Even, soft studio lighting highlighting the creamy texture and vibrant red berry topping.

elements.text:
Why you so quiet?
What's on your mind?

elements.description: Isolated side-profile slice of layered strawberry cream cake topped with red berry crumble.

ornaments.description: Hand-drawn white monoline illustration of a human head in left profile with a cutaway cranial window framing the cake slice.

why_it_works: Visual metaphor literally places the product inside the viewer's mind, creating an instant, memorable punchline for the headline.
High-contrast crisp white typography and line art pop cleanly against the rich, low-noise dark burgundy background.
Strict vertical symmetry and generous outer margins keep the eye locked onto the central gag and brand URL.
